result.title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
result.summary: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WorldLatent，用多模态 VAE 将 4D 外观、几何与动力学压缩融合为统一的结构化 latent，使感知与生成作为同一潜空间上的互补去噪过程在单次训练循环中联合学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将几何与动态压缩进统一潜变量的做法，可能为 LVR 中「内部状态是否保留视觉细节与几何证据」提供表示层面的借鉴线索；但论文目标在 4D 世界感知与生成，未涉及推理状态生成或证据使用，需核查后才知是否可迁移。
